newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixed at new 3-1/4 year low.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixed at new 3-1/4 year low.

text.p: The price of gold was fixed at $352.45 an ounce on Wednesday morning, the lowest setting since October 4, 1993.
Gold had been fixed at $357.40 an ounce on Tuesday, before heavy selling by investment funds in the New York market knocked values significantly lower.
Prices have slid about $15 since the start of the year amid overwhelmingly negative market sentiment, and analysts expect gold next to hit the psychological $350 an ounce level.
Below that little support was available until $345, they said.
A surging dollar and equity markets, along with a modest increase in December U.S. CPI inflation, prompted late Tuesday's fresh fund selling, traders said.
News on Monday that the Dutch central bank had sold 300 tonnes of gold was also hanging over the market, heightening fears that other central banks would do the same.
